segments.text: In the Third place; After the receiuing of the Sacraments, two things are required.

First, that Thankes be giuen vnto God, not onely in word, but in euery action of our life, for Christ, and all his benefits. Secondly, that not onely for the present, but euer afterward, still we renue our faith, repentance, and obedience.

But what is a man to doe, if after receiuing, he finde no cōfort? Ans. First he must examine, whether he hath truly beleeued and repented, yea or no; If he hath not, then the fault is in himselfe, and not in Gods ordinance. If he hath, let him not be dismaied, for the ioy of the Spirit is sowne in his heart; and though it lie hidde for a time, yet at length it will shewe it selfe. Psal. 97. 11.
